plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Agricultural Engineering Technology map for 2026-2027' and the pathway is for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every fixed course, category, unit value and term total; Table View shows no prerequisites column, so the 'Prerequisites' flags below are Card View only. The inventoried program 'Agricultural Engineering Technology' is listed in the mapper under that name; the program page states the student will be awarded an Associate of Science degree and prints no separate total-units statement. This plan transcribes the first-listed 2026-2027 pathway, 'Bakersfield College / Agricultural Engineering Technology / Associate of Science / 62-69.5 units / 4 terms / to CSU Bakersfield', in full; the page shows only the 4-term Bakersfield College segment. The second 2026-2027 pathway ('to Degree', 60-64.5 units, 4 terms) uses the Bakersfield College general-education pattern and is not collected as a separate plan. In 2025-2026 a detailed map with the same structure existed in 6 terms. The transcribed map prints term totals as 15-18.5 / 17-18 / 15-17 / 15-16. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Major List A' (2-3), 'Major List B' (3-4) and 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4); Term 3 'Major List D' (4-5) and 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4); Term 4 'Area 3B : Humanities' (3-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 62 units. MATH B1B and PHYS B2A are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; they are named major courses and are recorded with category 'major'. 'Major List E' is likewise printed 'Major / Gen Ed' and is recorded with category 'major'. MATH B1B, ENGR B24, PHYS B2A and ENGR B40 carry a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; no other row shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag, so no other prereqs are recorded. General-education and major-list slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. No separate Certificate program named Agricultural Engineering Technology exists in the mapper. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.'
